info.name: EventHub API - Event Ticketing and Venue Booking
info.description:
Success and error requests for every endpoint of the EventHub REST API.

Before running: start the backend (php artisan serve), reset the sample data (php artisan migrate:fresh --seed) and set the api_key collection variable. Run the folders in order: the login requests store each role's token in collection variables.
